title.zh: 将布拉干省安加特市镇比纳格巴格描笼涯比纳格巴格小学的名称变更为Francisco F. Illescas小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Binagbag Elementary School in Barangay Binagbag, Municipality of Angat, Province of Bulacan, to Francisco F. Illescas Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Binagbag Elementary School in Barangay Binagbag, Municipality of Angat, Province of Bulacan, to Francisco F. Illescas Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Binagbag tại Barangay Binagbag, Thị trấn Angat, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường tiểu học Francisco F. Illescas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Binagbag ในบารังไกย์ Binagbag, เทศบาล Angat, จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Francisco F. Illescas
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Binagbag di Barangay Binagbag, Kotamadya Angat, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Francisco F. Illescas
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Binagbag di Barangay Binagbag, Perbandaran Angat, Wilayah Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Francisco F. Illescas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6813_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Binagbag Elementary School located in Binagbag, Municipality of Angat, Province of Bulacan, is hereby renamed as Francisco F. Illescas Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
